rows.quote: The plasma proteomic data were derived from the UK Biobank Pharmaceutical Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP), while the EM dataset from the FinnGen consortium R10 release data.
rows.coder_note: 'FinnGen consortium R10 release data' names release R10 of FinnGen (rule A); nothing in the passages conflicts.

rows.quote: This project is a large-scale proteomic characterization study of 54,219 UK Biobank participants, and we selected 2,923 pQTLs from the baseline cohort (n = 34,557) (https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn51365301) for analyses.
rows.reference_quote: Sun BB Chiou J Traylor M Benner C Hsu YH Richardson TG . Plasma proteomic associations with genetics and health in the UK Biobank . Nature . ( 2023 ) 622 : 329–38 . doi: 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6 PMC10567551 37794186
rows.coder_note: The preceding sentence attributes the pQTL data to UKB-PPP (10), Sun 2023 by DOI, a source with several dictionary rows; the pinned sentence, the same description of the dataset (rule F), gives the cohort used as n = 34,557, the exact N of the discovery row alone (rule E); 54,219 describes the whole project and is no row's release N (rule H).
